name: 彭朋群
objective:
1. Introduction to Optical Sensing Technologies
2. Optical Sensing Devices
3. Light Sources and Photodetectors
4. Design and Architecture of Optical Sensing Systems
5. Signal Processing Techniques for Optical Sensing
6. Classification and Recognition of Optical Sensing Signals
7. Calibration and Stability Enhancement of Optical Sensing Systems  
8. Case Studies in Optical Sensing Applications
課程進度(1-16週):
1-2. Introduction to Optical Sensing Technologies
3-4. Optical Sensing Devices
5-6. Light Sources and Photodetectors
7-8. Design and Architecture of Optical Sensing Systems
9-10. Signal Processing Techniques for Optical Sensing
11-12. Classification and Recognition of Optical Sensing Signals
13-14. Calibration and Stability Enhancement of Optical Sensing Systems  
15-18. Case Studies in Optical Sensing Applications
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          安排兩週進行 AI 輔助自主學習，學生運用生成式 AI 工具探索光感測元件與系統相關主題，包括光纖感測、光學感測元件、感測原理、訊號處理及實際應用等，透過 AI 協助理解專業概念、比較不同感測技術及探索最新應用，並利用論文或可信資料來源查證 AI 所提供之資訊。學生須整理學習成果並撰寫心得報告，說明 AI 使用方式、專業知識收穫、資訊查證結果，以及對 AI 輔助光感測專業學習之優勢、限制與應用潛力的反思。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          繳交報告
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          10%
